item.title: ‘Abkhazia is not anyone’s showcase, and we did not ask Moscow for help’ — response to Russian propagandist’s article
item.description: Public figure Akhra Bzhaniya says it is unjust and futile to demand “feudal submission” from Abkhazia.

item.title: Partial reopening of Armenia–Turkey border expected, no date announced yet
item.description: According to Armenian media, the border will open on 1 February for third-country nationals and holders of diplomatic passports. Official Yerevan has neither confirmed nor denied these reports.

item.title: Suspected attack on Israel’s embassy in Baku said foiled
item.description: According to official information, the attack was being prepared by the Khorasan branch of the Islamic State group, known as Wilayat Khorasan.

item.title: iFact investigation finds 19 ships calling at Georgian ports match criteria of Russia’s ‘shadow fleet’
item.description: The journalists reached this conclusion after monitoring vessels calling at the ports of Batumi, Poti and Kulevi over a two-month period.

item.title: Georgia’s government approves national concept for reforming general education
item.description: Among other things, the concept envisages strengthening national identity, cultural distinctiveness and the state language.

item.title: The Hill: Oil company chief continues lobbying US Congress to drop sanctions on Georgia
item.description: The businessman argues that US companies operating in Georgia could become collateral damage of a political struggle.

item.title: ‘Armenia must not be an attractive target for aggression,’ says Pashinyan on Army Day
item.description: According to the prime minister, any country is “vulnerable without a strong army”, which is why Armenia is strengthening the defence capabilities of its armed forces. Former presidents, however, have accused the current authorities of “weakening the most combat-ready army in the region”.

item.title: Giga Avaliani case: What is known about murder of young teacher in Georgia
item.description: 28-year-old teacher died after being attacked by a group of teenagers in Tbilisi in October 2025.

item.title: Georgian Dream rolls out new law criminalising any cooperation with foreign foundations
item.description: Experts and entrepreneurs will also face fines and jail; party membership will be restricted, and leaders easier to arrest
